envelope.description: Pin deterministic runtime profiles and integrity metadata

body.title: Pin deterministic runtime profiles and integrity metadata
body.summary: Extend the existing private policy with deterministic distribution profiles, official archive byte counts and independently derived Node/inventory hashes. Include pinned official Windows header/library inputs when needed, without executing foreign binaries or enabling unqualified targets. Define bounded runtime receipt/inventory/result types and canonical layout without changing public contracts.
acceptanceChecks: All six declared os/arch policy identities retain Node22.22.1/npm10.9.4/header22.22.1 consistency; profile metadata is derived from verified official archive/assets and reproducible, not copied from an installed receipt.
Completion64KiB, inventory16MiB,32768 entries,128MiB/file,1GiB expanded,256MiB/compressed asset,600s network and120s verification bounds are explicit and tested.
RuntimeIdentity/ReleaseManifest/IPC fields remain unchanged; metadata computation alone neither executes target code nor enables a native target.
